description:
Starea, adresa publicată, motivul unui eșec sau al unei respingeri.

Use when you need the state, live URL or rejection reason of one publication. Do not use when listing: use list_publications.
name: get_publication

istoricModificari.description: array of {fel, la, versiune, sursa, sursaDetaliu, campuri?, stare?}. Changes after publication: EDITARE (saved) or CERERE_ACTUALIZARE (request sent to the team); sursa = PLATFORMA, API or MCP. A CERERE_ACTUALIZARE with stare PENDING is waiting for approval; APPLIED is live.

rejectionReason.description: string|null. Why the publication was refused, if it was.

status.description: string. AWAITING_APPROVAL, QUEUED, SCHEDULED, PUBLISHED, FAILED, CANCELLED.

title: O publicare
